Hypothesis: Exogenous variables beat price-history-only on at least some series
Key evidence (test set): E4 beats E0 on 16 / 20 series for RF; significant at all three horizons for Ridge and RF

Hypothesis: Tree ensembles beat a linear model
Verdict: Not supported as a general claim (mixed)
Key evidence (test set): RF/HGB win at h=4 (significant), Ridge wins at h=2 (significant), tie at h=1; Ridge with crop interactions is best overall

Hypothesis: Seasonal naive hard to beat for strongly seasonal series
Verdict: Partly supported (true for the one strongly seasonal crop only)
Key evidence (test set): only Maize (seasonal R2 0.84); there seasonal naive beats naive by 28.2%

Hypothesis: Corruption/missingness reduce accuracy, especially without handling
Verdict: Supported (clean < realistic < stressed with handling; ignoring data quality is far worse)
